material.locator: ILO Practical Guide (June 2026), printed pp. 30–33 (labour-force status, employment, unemployment and underutilization); pp. 57–58 (core labour-market indicators for international migrants); pp. 63–66 (source-specific coverage and limitations, including wages, contractual hours and administrative records).
material.description: Supports the use and interpretation of selected labour-force and labour-market indicators for international migrants, while identifying source-coverage and measurement limitations. This Guide is not cited as support for labour productivity comparability; the existing ILOSTAT Evidence Use remains the source path for the productivity component of the Claim.
